subject: n2r v3 draw-parameter/flat contract + tests; line-flat source discrepancy
body: Implemented additive n2r request fields in nord2_metal_render.h/.c. Render contract: n2r_build_v3(out, shader, request, addresses, n2r_texture_resources*, const struct n2r_draw_options* opts, index, next) and n2r_validate_v3. opts {version=1, flags, int32 vertex_base, uint32 base_instance}. Flags: FLAT_SHADING=1 -> TILER_CONTEXT.first_provoking_vertex (v9 word2 bit18); WRITE_VERTEX_BASE=2 -> signed vertexStart/baseVertex at vertex FAU byte64 (word17), requires vertex_fau_words>=17; WRITE_BASE_INSTANCE=4 -> uint32 baseInstance at FAU byte68 (word18), requires fau_words>=18, and n2r adds baseInstance*stride to input_rate ATTRIBUTE rows only. MALI_PRIMITIVE.base_vertex_offset stays0. v1/v2 NULL options are byte-identical, no tiler/FAU/BInstance writes. Render: keep current q->vertex vertexStart*stride pre-rebase for per-vertex attrs; n2r intentionally does NOT add vertex_base again. Do NOT pre-add baseInstance*stride to q->vertex; n2r does it for input_rate rows. Set flags from compiled vso.sysval_mask bits0x10/0x20 and pair2.flags&FLAT_SHADING; indexed baseVertex goes in vertex_base, nonindexed vertexStart too. Host test vs v9 pack oracle passes: tiler bit, FAU -3/5, primitive base offset0, per-vertex attr unchanged, instance attr offset16+5*4; default path no writes. n2r suite 10 PASS release+ASan. IMPORTANT line-flat discrepancy: pinned v9.xml has no DRAW.flat_shading_vertex field (only v4-v7), and Mesa pan_jm sets it only PAN_ARCH<=7; arch9 uses TILER first_provoking. n2r does not fabricate the overloaded word0 bit8 (overdraw_alpha1). Triangle flat is implemented via tiler; line-list flat remains an explicit unresolved hardware-contract gap, not claimed. If lowering insists on a line bit, provide exact arch9 XML/source field. No phone/build/commit/publish.
